title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.3 NOVA TITAN - Bulletproof System Restore & Safety Architecture
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.3 NOVA TITAN: (1) Bulletproof System Restore: Automatically unlocks 24-hour creation frequency limits, enables Drive C: System Protection, and starts Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) for 100% reliable safety checkpoint creation. (2) Esports Mouse Queue Buffer Selector & Lock: User-selectable buffer (8, 20, 32, 64) locked by Tweak Watchdog against hourly Windows resets. (3) Zero-Crash Universal Key Remapper: Full support for Delete and media keys with bulletproof null-safe event delegates. (4) Avatar Cropper Upgrade: 0.1x - 4.0x zoom range auto-fitting high-res gamer avatars with zero stuck dragging. (5) ExitLag-Style Auto-Ping DNS: Measures live ping latency on tab open with 1-click lowest-latency routing. (6) Esports Mic Isolation & De-Bleed: Disables Stereo Mix loopback, strips +30dB AGC noise boost, and locks clean source audio. (7) Discord Rich Presence Toggle: User preference toggle in Settings.
